DO NOT BUY - Misleading Subscription & Difficult Cancellation. initially signed up expecting a simple AI tool, but what I got instead was a poorly disclosed subscription model that charged me $14.99 without clear warning. There was no obvious indication during signup that I was enrolling in a recurring payment, which already raises concerns about transparency.
The biggest issue, however, is the cancellation process. Unlike most legitimate services that allow you to cancel directly in your account settings, this platform makes it unnecessarily complicated. I was instructed to:
Fill out an external “unsubscribe questionnaire” form
Log into a separate site
Navigate through multiple hidden menus just to find the cancellation option
This kind of process feels intentionally designed to discourage users from canceling. A trustworthy service should offer a simple, clearly visible “Cancel Subscription” button not send users through hoops and third-party forms.
On top of that, there’s confusion about account access. If you don’t remember exactly how you signed up or which email was used, you may not even be able to locate your subscription easily. That’s a major flaw in user experience and billing accountability.
Overall, this service gives the impression of prioritizing revenue over user trust. Between the unclear billing, lack of transparency, and unnecessarily difficult cancellation process, I would strongly advise others to be cautious before signing up.

Subpar Product and Poor Customer Service. This product is subpar, the billing is misleading, and the customer service is poor. When I contacted customer service to help and for a partial refund (as I did not want to continue using an unsatisfactory product), the just gave me instructions to cancel prospectively (which is needlessly complicated) and asked me to send screenshots of the issue. 

I explained to CS that there wasn’t. specific issue I could screenshot - the presentations generated are not high quality. I prompted the tool with very specific prompts, included starting points for the presentation, and provided data and information to use in the presentation. The results were always something a high schooler would have created and were not acceptable for use in a corporate setting. They were also poorly formatted. I spent more time editing the resulting presentations than I would have spent if I had just created the slides myself.

Solid AI Platform. PopAi is an early entrant into the multi-AI-toolbox market (That means they were thinking ahead before most people even knew what AI was or heard the acronym LLM). I’ve been a Pro subscriber for over a year now to PopAi, as well as many others in this space. Every startup is going to have its limitations and growing pains, but PopAi manages to stay competitive and has introduced several innovative products and tools that are next to none in some cases. 

That said, PopAI has a Swiss Army Knife approach: if it can be written, then PopAi has an AI solution. Advanced or Beginner, PopAI will probably emerge as one of the elite all-inclusive AI platforms in years to come. 

If you are having issues learning or adapting, refer to their “Resources” tab on the user-interface.

A Game-Changer for Summarizing Research Papers and Creating Presentations!. I have been a loyal user of the popai.pro for quite some time now, and it has been an invaluable tool for me. It allows me to effortlessly upload PDFs of research papers and quickly extract the key information, saving me hours of reading and summarizing. Additionally, the feature to generate PPT presentations based on the summarized content is a game-changer!

Now, with the PopAI mobile app, I can access all the amazing features of POPAI on the go. This means I no longer need to rely on other tools like GPT, PopAI has become my go-to solution for all my research needs. The convenience of having this functionality on my mobile device is a significant advantage, allowing me to work efficiently and effectively from anywhere.

I highly recommend PopAI to anyone who needs to stay on top of the latest research and wants to save time and effort in summarizing and presenting their findings. It's a must-have app for researchers, students, and professionals alike. Kudos to the PopAI team for creating such a fantastic tool!
